description: Syntax-check source files with the toolchains already installed (node --check, bash -n, perl -c, cc -fsyntax-only, gofmt -e, ruby -c, php -l, Python's parser, ...). Inline <script> blocks in HTML are checked too. Reports problems only; a missing toolchain is skipped.

commands.description: extra or overriding checkers: {".ext": "shell command with {f}"}; null disables one
